description: This file contains utility functions for migrating legacy chart customization data to the current format within the Superset project. It includes functions to identify legacy formats, extract dataset IDs and column names, and perform the migration of customization objects and arrays.

methods.name: isLegacyChartCustomizationFormat
methods.description: Type guard to check if an item is a legacy chart customization object.

methods.name: extractDatasetId
methods.description: Extracts a numeric dataset ID from various possible dataset representations.

methods.name: extractColumnName
methods.description: Extracts a column name from a string, array of strings, or null.

methods.name: migrateChartCustomization
methods.description: Converts a legacy chart customization item into the current ChartCustomization format.

methods.name: migrateChartCustomizationArray
methods.description: Converts an array of items, migrating legacy customization objects to the current format.
